correctness.rationale: The kernel of each irreducible tensor factor separates as ker(ρ)×ker(λ) because a scalar of p-power order equal to a scalar of q-power order must be 1. A faithful set of P-constituents contains a faithful subset of size d(Z(P)); a faithful set of A-characters requires at least d(A) constituents. These give the lower bound δ(P)+max(0,d(A)-d(Z(P))). Attaching generators of the dual of A to a minimum faithful representation of P and adding one-dimensional constituents only when d(A)>d(Z(P)) attains the bound. All assumptions and both boundary regimes are stated; no finite experiment is used for the universal claim.

value.rationale: The formula resolves a natural structural question raised by known mixed-prime failures of additivity: it gives the exact dimension saving, min(d(A),d(Z(P))), for the entire coprime abelian-factor family, not just isolated small groups. The correction depends on the center rank and the abelian factor rank and explains both directions of the boundary r≤s versus r>s.
